# Quotebook

> Quotebook (quotebook.me) is a quote discovery and creation platform with a searchable library of 1,000,000+ curated quotes, 100+ author collections, 290+ topic-specific quote pages across 36 categories, an AI-assisted Poster Studio for turning any quote into a downloadable HD photo poster, and a distraction-free full-screen "Zen Mode" reading experience with ambient photography and auto-narration controls.

Quotebook is built and maintained by Kaushal Patil ([GitHub: kforkaushal](https://github.com/kforkaushal)). The site is a static, client-rendered application (no login/account system) — every quote, author, and category page listed below is publicly and freely accessible with no paywall.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://quotebook.me/): Landing page: hero quote-of-the-day, live stats (1M+ quotes, 57 categories), Zen Mode showcase, and links into every part of the site.
- [Explore Quotes](https://quotebook.me/quotes.html): The main quote browser: search 1,000,000+ quotes by author, topic, or keyword; filter by author or sort order; view featured quotes; browse author story-style profile circles; open full-screen Zen Mode.
- [Poster Studio](https://quotebook.me/poster.html): Turn any quote (or a custom one) into a downloadable, high-resolution photo poster with Pixabay background photography, filters, and text styling — no login required.

## Quote Categories

36 topic hubs covering 291 individual, keyword-targeted quote pages — each page is a focused sub-topic within its parent category (e.g. "Birthday" contains separate pages for husband, wife, best friend, funny, religious, etc.). Useful for answering "quotes about X" or "quotes for Y occasion" queries with a direct, specific link rather than the general search page.
